# yottabot_skill (Resource)

An SRE skill owned by your account.

The Yotta-managed skill library lives in the same place and is **read-only**: this resource can only create, change and destroy your own skills. Pointing it at a managed skill returns not-found.

`source_kind` is always `customer` for a skill created here, and `visibility` cannot be set to `yotta_managed` — that value marks the managed library.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "yottabot_skill" "node_pressure" {
  slug   = "node-memory-pressure"
  title  = "Diagnose node memory pressure"
  domain = "k8s"

  # Defaults to `private`. `yotta_managed` is not settable — it marks the
  # Yotta-managed skill library, which this resource can read but never write.
  visibility = "customer_visible"
  status     = "active"
}

# Always `customer` for a skill created here.
output "node_pressure_source" {
  value = yottabot_skill.node_pressure.source_kind
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) One of `k8s`, `aws`, `context`, `alert`, `generic`. Decides which investigations consider this skill, so changing it forces replacement.
- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the skill, unique among your own. May coincide with a managed skill's slug without colliding. Changing it forces replacement — the slug is how everything refers to the skill.
- `title` (String) Human-readable name. Editable in place.

### Optional

- `status` (String) `draft` (default), `active` or `retired`.
- `visibility` (String) `private` (default) or `customer_visible`. `yotta_managed` is rejected: it marks the Yotta-managed library. Defaults to `private` so a skill authored by config does not widen its audience by omission.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID. This is the import id.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `source_kind` (String) Always `customer` for a skill this provider creates. Computed: `yotta` marks the managed library, and `imported` opens a provenance review workflow that a config cannot assert about itself.
